primitives.name: Criticality of the Two-Point Correlator in Deep Linear Networks (C_W = 1)
primitives.verbatim_quote: Thus, at least at this heuristic level of analysis, choosing CW = 1 appears to be essential for preserving the structure of the input data in a numerically stable manner. More generally, ﬂowing to a nontrivial ﬁxed point seems to be a necessary condition for deep networks to do anything useful.
primitives.latex: G^{(\ell+1)}_{\alpha_1\alpha_2} = C_W\, G^{(\ell)}_{\alpha_1\alpha_2}, \qquad G^{(\ell)}_{\alpha_1\alpha_2} = (C_W)^{\ell}\, G^{(0)}_{\alpha_1\alpha_2}; \qquad C_W = 1 \;\Rightarrow\; G^{(\ell)}_{\alpha_1\alpha_2} = G^{(0)}_{\alpha_1\alpha_2}\;(\text{criticality})
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: G^(ell)_{alpha1 alpha2}: two-point preactivation correlator / covariance at layer ell between inputs alpha1,alpha2 (units of signal variance, dimensionless for normalized inputs); C_W: rescaled weight-variance initialization hyperparameter (dimensionless); ell: layer depth (dimensionless integer count); G^(0): input inner product normalized by input dimension (signal-variance units); (C_W)^ell: dimensionless geometric growth/decay factor. The recursion multiplies a variance by a dimensionless constant, so it is dimensionally homogeneous; criticality C_W=1 is a dimensionless eigenvalue condition.
primitives.assumptions: Deep linear network (identity activation sigma(z)=z); all biases set to zero; weights drawn independently from zero-mean Gaussians with variance C_W/n_{ell-1}; layer-independent C_W; weight matrices mutually independent and independent of the input; statistics evaluated at initialization over the weight ensemble.
primitives.breakdown_regime: For C_W>1 the covariance blows up exponentially (divergent output, numerical instability); for C_W<1 it decays exponentially to zero (loss of all data dependence). These are the trivial fixed points G*=infinity and G*=0. The critical point C_W=1 is a measure-zero tuning; any deviation is amplified exponentially with depth. This is the baby version of the exploding/vanishing gradient problem; at finite width even C_W=1 does not tame higher-point fluctuations (see p2/p4).

primitives.name: Depth-to-Width Ratio as the Emergent Running Coupling (Connected Four-Point Correlator)
primitives.verbatim_quote: Thus, the deviation from inﬁnite width is proportional to the depth-to-width ratio of the network, our ﬁrst encounter with this important emergent scale. There are multiple ways to think about this ﬁnite-width correction.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: G^(ell)_4: layer-dependent scalar of the full four-point preactivation correlator (units of signal variance squared); G^(ell)_2: single-input covariance / two-point scalar (signal-variance units); (G^(ell)_2)^2: variance squared; n: hidden-layer width (dimensionless neuron count); ell: depth (dimensionless count); r=ell/n: depth-to-width aspect ratio (dimensionless); the connected four-point difference G_4-(G_2)^2 has units of variance squared, matching every term; 2(ell-1)/n is dimensionless. Dimensionally homogeneous throughout.
primitives.assumptions: Deep linear network at criticality (C_W=1 so G_2 is depth-independent); equal hidden-layer widths n_1=...=n_{L-1}=n; single input (sample indices dropped); leading order in the 1/n (large-width) expansion; weights Gaussian and independent across layers.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The leading 1/n correction is valid only while the depth does not grow too large (the O(1/n^2) and higher terms accumulate); the expansion breaks down when the aspect ratio r=ell/n is no longer perturbatively small. At large r the connected correlator grows exponentially (e^{2r}-1, Eq 3.56) rather than linearly, and perturbation theory fails. The connected four-point correlator is the measure of non-Gaussianity / intralayer interaction, so its growth signals the breakdown of the independent-neuron Gaussian description.
timescales: tau_1 (linear running with depth at small r)

layer2.mapping: Eq (3.28) is a discrete renormalization-group flow: the connected four-point correlator (the quartic coupling, measuring interaction / breakdown of statistical independence between neurons) runs with depth, growing as 2(ell-1)/n at criticality, with the depth-to-width ratio r=ell/n the emergent perturbative scale (double-scaling form (e^{2r}-1), Eq 3.56). This is isomorphic to the accumulation of correlation in the 22-player football dynamical system: the independent-play Gaussian approximation (each play's outcome statistically independent) breaks down as the ratio of drive depth ell (sequential coupled plays) to effective roster width n (independent parallel options/players) grows. The connected four-point correlator binds to the observable play-to-play covariance (fatigue, scheme adaptation, compounding field position); the state variable is the drive-state distribution; the constraint is the aspect ratio r=ell/n; the transition kernel is the play-to-play marginalization. Just as the network's quartic coupling runs with depth, a drive's play-to-play correlation runs with drive length, and the perturbative independent-agent description is valid only for small r.
layer2.telemetry: Calibrating observables: per-play outcome variance (two-point correlator G_2), play-to-play connected covariance (connected four-point G_4 - G_2^2), drive length ell (number of sequential plays), effective independent options n (roster width / parallel alternatives), and the aspect ratio r=ell/n. The running coupling is verified by measuring how play-to-play correlation grows with drive length on held-out drives: linear in ell/n for small r (perturbative), exponential e^{2r} for large r (chaotic / compounding). No sportsbook odds used.

primitives.name: General-Activation Criticality via the Parallel Susceptibility (chi_parallel(K*) = 1)
primitives.verbatim_quote: Thus, we see that in order to mitigate this exploding and vanishing kernel problem for a single input at linear order, we require the tuning of initialization hyperparameters (Cb, CW ) such that χ∥(K⋆ 00) = 1 , (5.11) with the ﬁxed-point value K⋆ 00 deﬁned implicitly through the ﬁxed-point equation (5.7).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: K^(ell)_{alpha beta}: neural-network kernel / infinite-width mean preactivation metric at layer ell (signal-variance units); K*_00: single-input fixed-point kernel value (signal-variance units), defined implicitly by K*_00 = C_b + C_W g(K*_00); chi_parallel(K): parallel susceptibility = C_W g'(K), a dimensionless linearized-recursion eigenvalue; C_W: rescaled weight variance (dimensionless); C_b: bias variance (signal-variance units); g(K): Gaussian expectation of activation products <sigma(z)sigma(z)>_K (units of K); g'(K)=dg/dK (dimensionless); Delta K^(ell)_00: kernel perturbation about the fixed point (units of K). chi_parallel is dimensionless and the Delta-K recursion is homogeneous in units of K.
primitives.assumptions: Infinite-width (leading order in 1/width) kernel recursion; layer-independent bias variance C_b and rescaled weight variance C_W; single-input (diagonal kernel) analysis; linearization about the fixed point K*_00 (small perturbations Delta K); Gaussian expectation over preactivations at each layer; the fixed point is defined implicitly by the fixed-point equation (5.7).
primitives.breakdown_regime: The linear-order condition chi_parallel=1 is necessary but not always sufficient: higher-order corrections O(Delta^{p>1}) can destabilize the fixed point (tanh/sin decay as a power law K~1/ell^q toward K*=0; SWISH/GELU approach a nonzero fixed point). At finite width, 1/n corrections shift the critical point. Activations that do not pass through the origin (sigmoid, softplus) admit no criticality. A second criticality condition from the two-input off-diagonal / distance perturbation D^(ell) is required to fully pin down (C_b,C_W).

primitives.name: Non-Commuting Width/Depth Limits and the Double-Scaling Interpolating Solution (Chaos)
primitives.verbatim_quote: This solution interpolates between the two extreme limits: by sending r →0 we recover the Gaussian limit (3.49), and by sending r →∞we recover the chaotic limit (3.50) that demonstrates the breakdown of criticality.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: G^(L)_{2m}: layer-dependent scalar of the full 2m-point preactivation correlator at the output layer L (units of signal variance to the m); G^(L)_2: output two-point covariance (signal-variance units); n: hidden-layer width (dimensionless count); L: depth (dimensionless count); r=L/n: fixed aspect ratio in the double-scaling limit (dimensionless); m: half the correlator order (dimensionless integer); e^{m(m-1)r}: dimensionless enhancement factor. Both sides carry units of variance^m; dimensionally homogeneous. The infinite-width limit gives G_{2m}=(G_2)^m (Gaussian/Wick); the infinite-depth limit gives exponential growth [c_{2m}(n)]^{L-1}(G_2)^m (chaos).
primitives.assumptions: Deep linear network at criticality (C_W=1); equal hidden-layer widths n; single input; double-scaling limit n,L->infinity with r=L/n fixed; fixed correlator order m (the interpolating solution can break down for sufficiently large m at any finite n,L); subleading terms L/n^2, L^3/n^5, ... neglected.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The two limits do not commute: width-first gives a Gaussian (no interactions, no representation learning), depth-first gives chaotic exponentially non-Gaussian outputs even at criticality. The interpolating solution is valid only for small-but-nonzero r and fixed m; for large r fluctuations dominate and the network is unusable, and for large enough m the exponential approximation fails at any finite n,L. This is the precise sense in which criticality (C_W=1) alone does not guarantee well-behaved deep networks.

reasoning_traces.think:
Roberts and Yaida's The Principles of Deep Learning Theory is a research monograph that recasts the statistics of deep neural networks as an effective field theory, in the lineage of statistical mechanics and the renormalization group. The microscopic law, the layer-by-layer forward pass, is manifest; the difficulty is the macroscopic question of why a network computes one function rather than another. The book's method is to treat the ensemble of randomly initialized networks as a statistical system, compute its correlators exactly where possible, and organize the finite-width corrections as a perturbative expansion in the inverse width. Four sovereign primitives were extracted, all with verbatim statements and exact source notation: the two-point criticality of deep linear networks (Chapter 3), the depth-to-width running of the quartic coupling (Chapter 3), the general-activation criticality condition via the parallel susceptibility (Chapter 5), and the non-commuting large-width and large-depth limits with their double-scaling interpolating solution (Chapter 3). Page citations use the book's printed pagination.

The deep linear network is the exactly-solvable blueprint; the authors' analogy is that it is to deep learning what the simple harmonic oscillator is to quantum mechanics. With linear activation and zero bias, the preactivation is a repeated matrix product of independent Gaussian weight matrices. The two-point correlator obeys the recursion G-ell-plus-one equals C-W times G-ell, solved by G-ell equals C-W to the ell times G-zero. This is a geometric flow in depth. If C-W exceeds one the covariance explodes; if C-W is below one it collapses to zero, erasing all data dependence. Only at C-W equals one is the covariance preserved exactly through arbitrary depth, a nontrivial fixed point. This is criticality, and it is the baby version of the exploding-and-vanishing-gradient problem. The dimensional content is clean: G is a signal variance, C-W is a dimensionless initialization hyperparameter, and the critical condition is a dimensionless eigenvalue equal to unity.

The four-point correlator reveals the emergent scale. Its connected part, the deviation from Gaussian Wick factorization, is G-four minus G-two squared, equal to the bracket (1 plus 2 over n) to the ell-minus-one minus one, times G-two squared, which at leading order is 2(ell-1) over n times G-two squared. The connected four-point correlator measures interaction, the breakdown of statistical independence between neurons. It grows linearly with depth and is suppressed by inverse width, so the controlling parameter is the depth-to-width ratio r equals ell over n. This is the book's central recurring theme: leading finite-width effects at criticality grow linearly with depth despite inverse-width suppression. In the action language the quartic coupling runs with the layer, exactly as a coupling runs under renormalization-group flow.

The general-activation criticality extends C-W equals one to any nonlinearity. The kernel recursion linearizes around its fixed point to Delta-K-ell-plus-one equals chi-parallel of K-star times Delta-K-ell, where the parallel susceptibility chi-parallel of K equals C-W times g-prime of K. Criticality is chi-parallel of K-star equals one, the marginal eigenvalue separating expansion from contraction. This is a genuine statistical-physics critical condition, and the book classifies activations into universality classes: scale-invariant activations give a line of fixed points; tanh and sin decay as a power law toward K-star equals zero; SWISH and GELU approach a nonzero fixed point; sigmoid and softplus admit no criticality at all because they do not pass through the origin.

The capstone is that the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits do not commute. Taking width to infinity at fixed depth gives a Gaussian, the neural-network Gaussian process, with no interactions and no representation learning; taking depth to infinity at fixed width gives chaotic, exponentially non-Gaussian outputs even at C-W equals one. The interpolating double-scaling limit holds r equals L over n fixed and yields G-2m tends to exp(m(m-1) r) times G-two to the m, which reduces to Gaussian as r tends to zero and to chaos as r tends to infinity. The connected four-point piece becomes (exp(2r) minus one) times G-two squared, reproducing the running coupling nonperturbatively. The breakdown regime is explicit: the perturbative description is valid only for small but nonzero r; when r is large, fluctuations dominate and the network is unusable.

The Layer-2 binding into the 22-player football dynamical system is an explicit isomorphism, not a fabricated origin. The connected four-point correlator, the measure of play-to-play non-independence, runs with the depth-to-width ratio exactly as the quartic coupling runs with depth. In a drive, the independent-play Gaussian approximation breaks down as the ratio of drive depth (sequential coupled plays) to effective roster width (independent parallel options) grows; fatigue, scheme adaptation, and compounding field position are the football observables that calibrate the running coupling. The state variable is the drive-state distribution, the constraint is the aspect ratio, and the transition kernel is the play-to-play marginalization. Telemetry is the per-play variance, the play-to-play connected covariance, drive length, and effective options, with no sportsbook odds. The cross-layer veto is that a high-EV play drawn from the independent-play approximation can be vetoed when the aspect-ratio telemetry says the drive is in the compounding, non-Gaussian regime. This is the sovereign content: a marginal-eigenvalue critical condition, a running coupling controlled by an emergent aspect ratio, and non-commuting limits, all dimensionally clean, all with explicit failure regimes.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The hidden state is the exploding-and-vanishing-gradient scar: the criticality condition was born from the historical failure of deep networks whose signals either blew up or died with depth. The lineage runs through Neal's 1996 infinite-width Gaussian-process limit, the renormalization-group program of statistical physics, and the recent finite-width recursions the authors cite. The deep linear network is deliberately chosen as the solvable blueprint, the harmonic oscillator of the field, so that the scar of non-commuting limits, width-first versus depth-first, is exposed exactly rather than hidden in approximation.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Under pressure the belief clash is three-way. The coach's comfort call assumes the independent-play Gaussian regime, each play treated as a fresh, uncorrelated draw. The defensive coordinator's tendency trap is a perturbation that deliberately drives the offense into the compounding, non-Gaussian regime, disguising coverage to force a sack and lengthen the drive. The quarterback's internal clock is the susceptibility estimate: it senses whether the drive-state kernel is near criticality or drifting toward the chaotic fixed point. Recursive modeling requires the quarterback to model the coordinator modeling the coach's independence assumption, and to recognize that the highest-EV play is exactly the one that pushes the aspect ratio past the perturbative boundary.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: The veto fires when the running-coupling physics overrides the point-estimate expected value. A comfort call with high EV under the independent-play approximation can be vetoed because the aspect-ratio telemetry shows the drive is in the compounding regime where play-to-play correlations grow exponentially rather than linearly. The statistical layer (the connected four-point correlator, the susceptibility) and the psychological layer (coach confidence in independence) jointly veto the naive EV-maximizing action. The adjudication rule: prefer the play whose worst-case loss scales perturbatively in the aspect ratio over the expert play whose worst-case loss scales exponentially, whenever the depth-to-width ratio exceeds the perturbative threshold.

universal_lens: A polymath audit lens reads these primitives as one template: a marginal-eigenvalue critical condition, a running coupling controlled by an emergent aspect ratio, and non-commuting limits that expose the boundary of the perturbative description. The lens asks of any deep system: what is its critical tuning, what scale controls its interactions, and do its limiting procedures commute?
gsi_mapping: For GSI's clinical and biomechanical telemetry the criticality/susceptibility kernel maps to motor-control stability: a movement network tuned to the marginal eigenvalue preserves signal through many joint segments, while off-critical tuning makes tremor explode or decay. The depth-to-width ratio maps to the ratio of sequential joint couplings to independent muscle synergies; the connected four-point correlator is the observable inter-muscle correlation. Telemetry: per-segment variance, inter-muscle covariance, segment count, synergy count. No odds.
gse_mapping: For GSE's Coach-Mind simulation and DFS/portfolio tail risk, the running-coupling kernel is the compounding-correlation veto: a drive or portfolio modeled as independent plays fails when the aspect ratio of sequential coupled steps to independent options grows. The double-scaling solution separates the perturbative regime from the chaotic tail. Telemetry: per-play variance, play-to-play connected covariance, drive length, effective options, aspect ratio. The engine queues but never publishes; no sportsbook odds as inputs.
